The '''BL-N3 Power Droid''' was available during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]] between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|reconstituted Sith Empire]].
{{Droid-stub}}

==Behind the scenes==
The BL-N3 Power Droid first appeared in ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]'' as a pet.
